parts.text: Which claim about these changes is best?

options.text: Change 1 is physical because no new substance forms; Change 2 is chemical because ash and smoke are new substances.
Both changes are chemical because the paper looks different afterward.
Change 2 is physical because heat alone never makes a new substance.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

stem:
Seema carries out two changes.
Change 1: she folds a clean sheet of paper into a smaller square.
Change 2: she burns a corner of another sheet until black ash and smoke form.

part_answers.answer: Folding keeps the same paper; burning forms new substances such as ash and smoke.

teacher.key_rationale: A physical change leaves the same substance; a chemical change forms new substances. Folding is physical; burning is chemical.
